svg.title: Agent Metro: the repository-driven workflow as a transit map
svg.desc: Four lines share the Request, Authority, and Work shape interchanges. L1 read-only runs to Report. L2 bounded change runs through Proof to Report. L3 durable change runs through Proof and Report, then loops through the docs/ memory depot back to Authority. L4 decision-blocked stops before mutation and returns to Request.
svg.text: Every request rides one of four lines. Change at Authority, prove before you arrive.

g.text: ask the smallest human question, then reboard
